title: Traffic of your sites
privacy: Read from Traefik's metrics: volumes, errors and response times per service. No visitor address is involved.
none: No traffic recorded in this period yet.
setup.title: Turn on the statistics
setup.step1: 1. Add this to Traefik's static configuration (the Static config view can edit it). The entry point must NOT be published: do not list port 8082 in the container's ports.
setup.step2: 2. Give the worker the address of that entry point, on the same Docker network (worker environment):
setup.step3: 3. Restart Traefik and the worker, then use "Test the connection".
